structured.reason: The mutant returns an instance of any other Pydantic model unchanged, so the router can hand back an object that isn't the requested model and was never checked against its schema. The original validates or rejects such objects, as the requirement's promises to reconstruct the requested model and not weaken router-side validation demand.
sources: Pydantic model types shall preserve their generated schema and reconstruct the requested model from valid JSON output.
Provider-specific schema transforms shall not weaken router-side validation.
A Pydantic model type retains its generated schema and valid JSON reconstructs the requested model type.
structured.test_focus: Call the parser with requested model A and an instance of a different model class B. The result must be an instance of A (a validated conversion), or a ValidationError must be raised when B's fields don't satisfy A; B must never come back unchanged.
